fusions.name: Raw Draught
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of raw arcana 5 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores resistances. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Distilled Spark
fusions.desc: Fires a spark that deals 4 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tapped Cask
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds and 10 health to you.

fusions.name: Spellfed Vigour
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
